# turingpi_usb_status (Data Source)

Retrieves the current USB configuration of the Turing Pi 2 including which node is connected, the USB mode, and the routing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "turingpi_usb_status" "current" {}

output "usb_status" {
  value = {
    node  = data.turingpi_usb_status.current.node
    mode  = data.turingpi_usb_status.current.mode
    route = data.turingpi_usb_status.current.route
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `mode` (String) The current USB mode (Host, Device, or Flash).
- `node` (String) The node currently connected via USB.
- `route` (String) The current USB routing (USB-A or BMC).
